name: SAGE-IDOT rail crossings
description: Three SAGE nodes, W042, W065 and W06E, watching Illinois Department of Transportation rail crossings from July 2025: a snapshot of each crossing every 5 minutes, and the objects YOLOv5n, YOLOv8n and YOLOv10n detected in a new image about every 3 seconds, one JSON Lines file per crossing and month. Each crossing's month is a row of its own.

resources.name: Crossing snapshots
resources.description: A snapshot every 5 minutes, named by when it was taken in nanoseconds since 1970 (ns): taken_at is that time in UTC.

resources.name: Detections
resources.description: One row per object a YOLO model detected in an image: its class, confidence and box in pixels (x0, y0, x1, y1), the image's time (image_timestamp_ns) and the model's inference time. Lines of other kinds are skipped and counted.

resources.name: Frames by model
resources.description: One row per image and YOLO model, also when the model saw nothing: its total_objects, its counts by class as JSON text, and its inference time. Lines of other kinds are skipped and counted.
